narr: An area of low pressure that moved in from the eastern Pacific combined with abundant low-level moisture with precipitable water values exceeding 1, which is near record levels for early June, to result in pockets of showers and thunderstorms across portions of southeast CA during the afternoon and evening hours on the 3rd. An area of heavy rainfall developed along west-central Imperial County along Fish Creek Wash, resulting in amounts exceeding 1 in less than an hour, leading to flash flooding.
ev: Video showed Fish Creek Wash experienced flooding, making a low water crossing along Split Mountain Road impassable. Timing estimated from radar. No damages nor injuries were reported.
lsr: ***DELAYED REPORT*** Video showed Fish Creek Wash had experienced flooding, making a low water crossing along Split Mountain Road impassable. Timing estimated from radar.
